commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The backs were filed clean. There are no names here.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I signed that order. I thought the mill kept the originals.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Thinking is not the same as asking.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The totals do not match. These workers delivered more than they were paid for.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The dispatch rack holds the next set. I can show you.
Mera wraps the plates separately. An empty space is still evidence when someone made it empty.
